name: Riken Keiki Co., Ltd.
summary: Riken Keiki Co., Ltd. engages in research, development, manufacturing, sales and after-sales maintenance of industrial gas detection and alarm equipment and analyzers in Japan and internationally. It offers gas detection and indicator alarm systems, portable and personal gas monitors, portable gas leak checkers, gas diffusion measurement services, toxic gas monitoring systems, oxygen monitoring systems, portable combination gas monitors, optical gas detection tubes, auto-emission analyzers, surface analyzers, medical gas indicators, and SALCON, a portable salinity analyzer.
